tagline: Every layout of the template in one deck

slides.title: Hello !
slides.lead: A short italic lead sentence that tells the audience what this deck is about.
paragraphs: First paragraph. Two or three sentences work best here.
Second paragraph. Leave it out if you only need one.

slides.title: Section Header
slides.text: A wide photo on top, a big title and one paragraph. Use it to open a part of the deck.

slides.title: Three Cards
slides.text: A paragraph on the left and up to three cards on the right.

cards.body: About 200 characters fit in a card.
Leave cards out and they disappear.

slides.title: Team
slides.text: Up to three people with photo, name, role and note.

slides.title: Two Cards
slides.text: A paragraph, two cards and a tall photo.

slides.title: People Grid
slides.text: Up to four people in a grid.

slides.title: Chart Slide
slides.text: A native chart in the dark card. Right-click it in PowerPoint to edit the data.

slides.title: Timeline
slides.text: Up to four columns with two items each.

slides.title: Analysis
slides.text: Text on the left, a chart on the white card.

slides.title: Stat and Chart
slides.text: A paragraph, one big number and a chart.
slides.stat_text: One sentence that explains the number.

slides.title: Gallery
slides.text: Three photos. Slots without a file keep the template photo.

slides.title: Testimonial
slides.lead: Up to four quotes with a star rating.

items.name: Reviewer One
items.text: A short quote of one or two sentences.

items.name: Reviewer Two
items.text: Ratings from 1 to 5 fill the stars.
